title: Closing performances are always so special but this one was next leve...
transcript: if you have not been able to attend a closing performance before I got to attend the final performance of Fat Ham on Broadway, and let me tell you, I highly recommend it! The energy in the room was electric and the audience was just there to shower the show with so much love. Every single actor got entrance applause, every single joke got tons of cheers and laughs, the audience was up dancing at the end. It was just so clear that everyone in the audience was there because they love this play, they love this cast, they love this production, and they wanted to be there to send it out with so much love. In fact after the show ended, the cast took their bows they left the stage, the audience just kind of sat there because we didn't want it to be over. And then the cast and the crew just came out on stage and we all started applauding again and they brought out the director, the producers, the writer of the play, and the audience just kind of applauded all of them for probably 5 minutes. I honestly think the audience just would have kept applauding forever, but the playwright literally had to step forward and be like, “You guys can go home now” and then they all left the stage and that's when the audience started filing out. As is often the case with final performances, there were some celebrities there. Andre de Shields was there, I even ran into Melissa McCarthy on the way out. And I'm sure there were more that I didn't even spot. But I just think that the show in particular is so special and while I'm sad to see it closing on Broadway I am glad that it will be at like every regional theater across America. There's like 9 or 10 productions that are popping up in the next year so if you live near a major metropolitan city chances are there's production of Fat Ham coming near you! There's one in Boston, there's one in DC, there's one in Chicago, there's one in LA, there's one everywhere 😂 Do if this play is coming anywhere near you I highly suggest you run to go see it because it really is just such a great play! One of my favorite things I've ever seen, and one of Melissa McCarthy favorite things she's ever seen! So definitely worth your time if you can check it out!
